name: DescribeDisks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. The value must be a number that is greater than 0.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
查询列表的页码。起始值为1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值为50行。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the disk. Valid values:

In-use: The disk is in use.

Available: The disk is available.

Attaching: The disk is being attached.

Detaching: The disk is being detached.

Creating: The disk is being created.

ReIniting: The disk is being re-initialized.

Deleting: The disk is being deleted.

Deleted: The disk is deleted.

Expiring: The disk is about to expire
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘状态。

In-use：使用中
Available：待挂载
Attaching：挂载中
Detaching：卸载中
Creating：创建中
ReIniting：重置中
Deleting：释放中
Deleted：已释放
Expiring：即将过期
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the disk. Valid values:

system: system disk

data: data disk
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘属性

system：系统盘
data：数据盘
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk

cloud_ssd: standard SSD

local_hdd: local HDD

local_ssd: local SSD
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘种类。

高效云盘：cloud_efficiency
全闪云盘：cloud_ssd
本地HDD盘：local_hdd
本地盘SSD：local_ssd
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the disk. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型。

prepay：预付费
postpay：按量付费
parameters.name: disk_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The sorting order. The value is a JSON string. Example: {"EnsRegionId":"desc"}. By default, results are sorted by node ID in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序使用：格式例子{"EnsRegionId":"desc"}。默认按节点ID降序排列
parameters.name: order_by_params

parameters.help_en:
The purchasing model of the disk. Valid values:

ServiceDisk: The disk is created for an edge service.

ResoureDisk: The disk is purchased with the instance.

PostPayDisk: The disk is purchased separately
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘购买方式。

ServiceDisk：边缘服务创建磁盘
ResoureDisk：随实例购买
PostPayDisk：单独购买
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: The instance to which the disk is attached
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 0 indicates a successful response
Code.description_zh: 返回的业务码，正常成功为0

Category.description_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

`cloud_efficiency`: Efficiency Cloud Disk

`cloud_ssd`: SSD Cloud Disk

`local_hdd`: local HDD

`local_ssd`: local SSD
Category.description_zh:
磁盘种类。

高效云盘：cloud_efficiency
全闪云盘：cloud_ssd
本地HDD盘：local_hdd
本地盘SSD：local_ssd

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the disk was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间。时间格式以ISO8601为标准，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the disk is released when the instance is released. Valid values:

`true`: The disk is released when the instance is released.

`false`: The disk is not released when the instance is released
DeleteWithInstance.description_zh:
是否随实例释放。可能值：

true：释放实例时，这块磁盘随实例一起释放。
false：释放实例时，这块磁盘保留不释放

DiskChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the disk. Valid values:

prepaid: subscription

postpaid: pay-as-you-go
DiskChargeType.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘的计费方式。取值：

prepaid：包年包月。
postpaid：按量付费

Encrypted.description_en:
Indicates whether the disk is encrypted. Valid values:

true: The disk is encrypted.

false: The disk is not encrypted
Encrypted.description_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

EncryptedKeyId.description_en: The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used for the disk
EncryptedKeyId.description_zh: 云盘使用的 KMS 密钥 ID

EnsRegionId.description_en: The ID of the Edge Node Service (ENS) node

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the disk is attached

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the instance to which the disk is attached

Portable.description_en:
Indicates whether the disk can be detached. Valid values:

`true`: The disk can exist independently and can be attached to or detached from an instance in the same zone.

`false`: The disk cannot exist independently. Its lifecycle is bound to that of the instance.

The Portable property is false for the following disk types:

Local HDD

Local SSD

Subscription data disk
Portable.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘是否支持卸载。取值：

true：支持。可以独立存在，且可以在可用区内自由挂载和卸载。
false：不支持。不可以独立存在，且不可以在可用区内自由挂载和卸载。

以下类型块存储的Portable属性都为false，生命周期与实例等同：

本地HDD盘
本地SSD盘
包年包月数据盘

SerialId.description_en: The serial number of the disk

Size.description_en: The size of the disk. Unit: MiB

SnapshotId.description_en: The ID of the snapshot from which the disk is created

Status.description_en:
The status of the disk. Valid values:

`In-use`: The disk is in use.

`Available`: The disk is available for attachment.

`Attaching`: The disk is being attached.

`Detaching`: The disk is being detached.

`Creating`: The disk is being created.

`ReIniting`: The disk is being re-initialized
Status.description_zh:
磁盘状态。
In-use：使用中
Available：待挂载
Attaching：挂载中
Detaching：卸载中
Creating：创建中
ReIniting：重置中

Type.description_en:
The type of the disk. Valid values:

`1`: system disk

`2`: data disk
Type.description_zh:
云盘或本地盘类型。取值：

1：系统盘
2：数据盘

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 分页查询时分页总页数
